title: fix(vulkan): add fence wait+reset before vkQueueSubmit in VKDRV_SubmitAndPresent
description:
## Problem

VKDRV_SubmitAndPresent() passes  to vkQueueSubmit without first waiting on it. The comment on line 1089 says the fence is already waited on and reset in VKDRV_AcquireNextImage(), but this creates a fragile dependency: if VKDRV_AcquireNextImage() was not called for the current frame slot (e.g., due to early returns, re-acquire logic, or race conditions), the fence may still be signaled from a previous frame or in an inconsistent state, causing VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST (-4).

## Root Cause

The fence synchronization in VKDRV_SubmitAndPresent is not self-contained. It assumes VKDRV_AcquireNextImage() has been called for the current frame slot, which resets the fence. When that assumption breaks, vkQueueSubmit receives an already-signaled fence, which is undefined behavior and causes device loss.

## Fix

In , function VKDRV_SubmitAndPresent(), before the vkQueueSubmit call (currently at line 1106), add:

1.  to check if the fence is already signaled
2.  with  and  timeout if not signaled
3.  to reset the fence before submit

This makes fence synchronization self-contained and removes the fragile dependency on VKDRV_AcquireNextImage having been called for the current frame slot.

## Files
-  — VKDRV_SubmitAndPresent() (lines 1071-1132)

## Acceptance Criteria
- vkQueueSubmit is always preceded by fence status check + wait + reset
- The fix is self-contained and does not depend on call order
- No regression in frame timing or double-buffering behavior

## Goal
Implement the staging buffer pool and GPU upload path for textures and static buffers, with proper image layout transitions.

## Files
- CREATE: code/vulkan/vk_upload.h
- CREATE: code/vulkan/vk_upload.c

## Staging Buffer Pool
- Pool of reusable HOST_VISIBLE buffers
- Buffers are returned to pool after copy fence signals
- Pool grows as needed; tracks total allocated memory

## Upload Path (textures)
1. Allocate staging buffer sized to mip chain (width * height * 4 * numMips)
2. Copy pixel data into staging buffer via mapped pointer
3. Record vkCmdCopyBufferToImage on transfer command buffer
4. Image layout transitions: UNDEFINED → TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL → SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
5. Submit transfer; signal a fence
6. Free staging buffer after fence signals (deferred to next BeginFrame of same slot)

## Upload Path (static buffers)
1. Allocate staging buffer
2. Copy data to staging buffer
3. Record vkCmdCopyBufferToBuffer
4. Submit with fence
5. Free staging after fence signals

## Functions
- VkDrv_InitUpload() — Create staging buffer pool, transfer command pool/buffer
- VkDrv_UploadTexture(const byte* data, VkImage image, int width, int height, int mipLevels) — Full texture upload with layout transitions
- VkDrv_UploadBuffer(void* dst, const void* src, size_t size) — Static buffer upload
- VkDrv_WaitPendingUploads() — Wait on transfer fences, free completed staging buffers
- VkDrv_DestroyUpload() — Wait on all pending transfers, destroy all resources

## Synchronization
- Transfer fence per upload operation
- CPU waits on transfer fence before freeing staging buffer
- No vkQueueWaitIdle — use per-operation fences

## Reference
- code/d3d11/d3d_image.cpp (D3D11 texture upload pattern)
- VMA documentation for staging allocations

## Acceptance Criteria
- Texture upload produces correct pixel data on GPU
- Image layout transitions are correct (verified by validation layers)
- Staging buffer pool reuses buffers after fence completion
- No memory leak — staging buffers are freed after upload completes
- Upload can be called during frame recording (async with GPU)

## Descriptor Set Layout (fixed, 3 sets)
- **Set 0** — Per-frame globals (uniform buffer):
  - Binding 0: UniformBuffer — view/projection matrices, time, screen size
- **Set 1** — Per-draw data (push constants or UBO):
  - Push constants preferred if ≤ 128 bytes; UBO otherwise
  - Model matrix, surface parameters
- **Set 2** — Textures (combined image samplers):
  - Binding 0: CombinedImageSampler — diffuse texture
  - Binding 1: CombinedImageSampler — lightmap texture
  - Binding 2: CombinedImageSampler — normal map (optional)
  - Binding 3: CombinedImageSampler — specular map (optional)

title: Implement per-frame dynamic vertex ring buffer
description: Create 4 MB per-frame vertex ring buffer with HOST_VISIBLE | HOST_COHERENT. Track current offset, reset at BeginFrame. If overflow occurs, flush and wrap with warning log. Used for dynamic surfaces, decals, and UI quads. Match the DynamicBuffer pattern from d3d_common.h.

title: Implement frame overlap command buffer management (vk_cmd.c)
description: Implement FRAME_OVERLAP=2 ring buffer: per-slot command pool + command buffer, in-flight fence, acquire semaphore, render semaphore. BeginFrame: acquire swapchain image, wait fence, reset pool, begin recording. EndFrame: end recording, submit with semaphore chain, present. Implement GFX_EndFrame and GFX_Flush.

title: Implement per-frame uniform buffer and descriptor set binding
description: Create persistent mapped uniform buffer with one region per frame slot for view/projection matrices, time, screen size. Update at BeginScene. Bind descriptor set 0 (per-frame globals) at start of each frame. Implement GFX_SetProjectionMatrix, GFX_GetProjectionMatrix, GFX_SetModelViewMatrix, GFX_GetModelViewMatrix.

title: Implement GFX_DrawStageGeneric
description: Implement the primary draw path for tessellated geometry: receive shaderCommands_t, upload vertices to ring buffer, bind appropriate pipeline (from PSO cache), bind descriptor sets (per-frame + textures), record vkCmdDrawIndexed. Handle shader state changes with pipeline switches. Reference GLRB_StageIteratorGeneric in gl_shade.c and D3DDrv_DrawStageGeneric in d3d_driver.cpp.

title: Implement GFX_DrawStageVertexLitTexture
description: Implement vertex-lit textured draw path. Same structure as DrawStageGeneric but uses vertex lighting shader variant. Bind vertex lit pipeline, pass vertex colors through. Reference GLRB_StageIteratorVertexLitTexture and D3DDrv_DrawStageVertexLitTexture.

title: Implement GFX_DrawStageLightmappedMultitexture
description: Implement lightmapped multitexture draw path. Bind two texture samplers (diffuse + lightmap), use multitexture shader variant. Handle lightmap texture coordinate offsetting. Reference GLRB_StageIteratorLightmappedMultitexture and D3DDrv_DrawStageLightmappedMultitexture.

title: Implement GFX_BeginTessellate and GFX_EndTessellate
description: Implement tessellation buffer management. BeginTessellate: reset local vertex/normal/texcoord/color arrays, capture shader state from shaderCommands_t. EndTessellate: flush accumulated vertices to ring buffer, bind pipeline, issue draw call. Match the OpenGL tessellation pattern from gl_driver.c.

title: Phase 6: 2D/UI Rendering Path
description: Orthographic projection setup, 2D pipeline (no depth test/write, alpha blending), GFX_DrawImage implementation, GFX_ResetState2D, and dynamic vertex batching for UI quads.

title: Implement 2D pipeline creation (orthographic, no depth, alpha blend)
description: Create dedicated 2D pipeline: orthographic projection matrix, depth test disabled, depth write disabled, alpha blending enabled. Uses the '2d' shader variant (fsq shaders). Implement the orthographic projection calculation matching the OpenGL driver.

title: Implement GFX_ResetState2D and GFX_ResetState3D
description: GFX_ResetState2D: switch to orthographic projection, bind 2D pipeline, disable depth test/write, enable alpha blending. GFX_ResetState3D: restore perspective projection, reset state mask to GLS_DEFAULT. Match the state reset behavior of the OpenGL driver.

title: Implement GFX_DrawImage with vertex batching
description: Implement GFX_DrawImage: receive image_t + coords + texcoords + color, generate quad vertices into dynamic ring buffer, bind texture, batch consecutive calls with same pipeline/texture. Flush when pipeline or texture changes. Reference GLRB_DrawImage and D3DDrv_DrawImage.

title: Phase 7: Special Features - Skybox, Beams, Shadows, Fog, Portals
description: GFX_DrawSkyBox (depth-less cube rendering), GFX_DrawBeam (segmented line rendering with texture), GFX_ShadowSilhouette/GFX_ShadowFinish (shadow volume rendering), GFX_SetPortalRendering (scissor/viewport flipping), and fog volume rendering.

title: Implement GFX_DrawSkyBox
description: Implement skybox rendering: depth write disabled, depth compare LESS_OR_EQUAL. Render as a cube around the eye origin. Use skybox shader variant. Accept skyboxDrawInfo_t with face textures, eye origin, and color tint. Reference D3DDrv_DrawSkyBox implementation for cube geometry construction.

title: Implement GFX_DrawBeam
description: Implement beam rendering: receive start/end points array, segment count, texture, color. Generate ribbon geometry (textured quad strips between consecutive points). Upload to dynamic ring buffer. Use generic unlit shader with alpha blending. Reference GLRB_DrawBeam and D3DDrv_DrawBeam.

title: Implement GFX_ShadowSilhouette and GFX_ShadowFinish
description: Implement shadow volume rendering. ShadowSilhouette: receive edge array, build shadow volume geometry. ShadowFinish: submit shadow volume rendering commands. Use stencil-based shadow volume approach matching the D3D11 driver. Reference gl_shadows.c and d3d_draw.cpp for the shadow rendering pipeline.

title: Implement GFX_SetPortalRendering
description: Implement portal rendering: enable/disable scissor-based rendering with flip matrix and plane. When enabled, apply flip matrix to projection, set scissor to portal bounds. Used for mirror/reflection surfaces. Reference GLRB_SetPortalRendering and D3DDrv_SetPortalRendering.

title: Implement fog volume rendering support
description: Implement fog rendering as a separate pass after opaque geometry. Use depth test LESS_OR_EQUAL with depth write off and additive/src-alpha blending. The fog shader stage is invoked through GFX_DrawStageGeneric with appropriate state - ensure the PSO cache handles fog blend states. Reference tr_flares.c and the OpenGL fog shader implementation.

title: Phase 8: Screenshots & Readback - ReadPixels, ReadDepth, ReadStencil
description: GFX_ReadPixels (swapchain image blit to host-visible buffer), GFX_ReadDepth, GFX_ReadStencil. Staging buffer allocation, layout transitions, synchronization with render fence.

title: Implement GFX_ReadPixels
description: Implement GFX_ReadPixels: create host-visible VkBuffer of size width*height*4, wait on render fence, blit swapchain image (transition to TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, copy to buffer, transition back), map buffer and return pixel data. Handle BGR→RGB conversion and Y-flip if needed. Match OpenGL driver's pixel format output.

title: Implement GFX_ReadDepth and GFX_ReadStencil
description: Implement GFX_ReadDepth: read depth attachment to host buffer as float array. Implement GFX_ReadStencil: read stencil attachment to host buffer as byte array. Use vkGetBufferSubData or blit-to-buffer approach. Reference D3DDrv_ReadDepth and D3DDrv_ReadStencil.

title: Phase 9: Swapchain Recreation & Resize Handling
description: Handle VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR and VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR from acquire/present. Full swapchain recreation flow: device idle, destroy framebuffers/views/depth, recreate swapchain, recreate framebuffers. Window resize cvar integration.

title: Implement swapchain recreation on VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR / VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR
description: Detect VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR and VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR from vkAcquireNextImageKHR and present. On error: call vkDeviceWaitIdle, destroy framebuffers + swapchain image views + depth image, recreate swapchain (pass old swapchain handle), recreate framebuffers. Do NOT recreate pipelines, descriptor pools, or command pools. Reference the D3D11 swapchain resize handling.

title: Implement window resize handling and GFX_SetViewport/GFX_SetScissor
description: Handle window resize events (triggered by engine when window size changes). Recreate swapchain with new dimensions. Implement GFX_SetViewport: set viewport with negative height for Y-flip via VK_KHR_maintenance1. Implement GFX_SetDepthRange. Implement GFX_SetDrawBuffer.

title: Implement GFX_MakeCurrent
description: Implement GFX_MakeCurrent: handle context activation/deactivation. When deactivated, stop recording commands. When reactivated, ensure swapchain is valid (recreate if needed). Reference GLRB_MakeCurrent and D3DDrv_MakeCurrent.

## Frame Overlap Ring
- FRAME_OVERLAP (default 2) frame slots
- Each slot owns:
  - One primary VkCommandPool + VkCommandBuffer
  - One in-flight VkFence
  - One acquire VkSemaphore (swapchain image available)
  - One render VkSemaphore (rendering complete)
  - Per-frame dynamic UBO region (from mapped persistent buffer)
  - Per-frame descriptor sets for dynamic data

## Frame Lifecycle


## Functions
- VkDrv_InitCommandBuffers() — Create command pools/buffers, fences, semaphores for all frame slots
- VkDrv_BeginFrame() — Acquire swapchain image, wait fence, reset pool, begin recording
- VkDrv_GetCommandBuffer() — Return current frame's recording command buffer
- VkDrv_EndFrame() — End recording, submit, present, advance frame index
- VkDrv_HandleSwapchainRecreation() — Called when acquire/present returns OUT_OF_DATE_KHR
- VkDrv_DestroyCommandBuffers() — vkDeviceWaitIdle, destroy all command resources

## Synchronization
- Acquire semaphore per frame slot
- Render semaphore per frame slot
- In-flight fence per frame slot — CPU waits here before reusing slot
- No vkQueueWaitIdle except during Shutdown and full swapchain recreation

## Reference
- code/d3d11/d3d_driver.cpp:D3DDrv_EndFrame (EndFrame pattern)
- code/d3d11/d3d_draw.cpp (command recording context)

## Acceptance Criteria
- Frame overlap ring correctly cycles through FRAME_OVERLAP slots
- CPU waits on fence before reusing a slot's resources
- Semaphore chain: acquire → render → present is correct
- Command pool reset at BeginFrame is correct (whole pool reset)
- Swapchain recreation is handled without driver crash
- No vkQueueWaitIdle during normal operation

title: Add double-clear guard to VKDRV_BeginFrame
description: Add a per-frame-slot boolean array g_vkFrameBegun[FRAME_OVERLAP] to detect and prevent double calls to VKDRV_BeginFrame(). The Quake 3 engine calls GFX_Clear from multiple code paths per frame, each of which calls VKDRV_BeginFrame and resets the command buffer, discarding previously recorded commands. Fix: 1) Declare g_vkFrameBegun[VK_MAX_FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT] (bool or int) in vk_device.cpp as a static array initialized to false. 2) In VKDRV_BeginFrame(), check if g_vkFrameBegun[g_vkCurrentFrame] is already true — if so, log a warning via ri.Printf(PRINT_DEVELOPER, "WARNING: double VKDRV_BeginFrame for frame slot %d\n") and return early. 3) Set g_vkFrameBegun[g_vkCurrentFrame] = true at the start of successful execution. 4) Reset the guard to false after advancing g_vkCurrentFrame in VKDRV_SubmitAndPresent() (at the end of the function, after the submit/present). This prevents command buffer reset from discarding recorded render commands.

Execute the complete testing and validation checklist from the Vulkan driver specification. Verify all driver interface entry points, visual correctness, stability, performance, and platform coverage.

- [ ] All 45 driver interface entry points implemented; no stubs left returning without action
- [ ] r_drawWorld 0 disables world rendering without crash
- [ ] r_drawEntities 0 disables entity rendering without crash
- [ ] All Q3 test maps load and render without visual corruption
- [ ] Multi-pass Q3 shaders (e.g., textures/base_wall/proto_block, animated shaders) render correctly
- [ ] Fog volumes match OpenGL reference
- [ ] Skybox renders without seams or Z-fighting
- [ ] UI, console, and HUD render correctly at all resolutions
- [ ] Screenshots produce correct pixel output

### Stability
- [ ] No validation layer errors or warnings at ERROR/WARNING severity in any test map
- [ ] Swapchain resize (window drag) does not crash or corrupt rendering
- [ ] Minimize/restore cycle recovers correctly
- [ ] Running for 10+ minutes in a multiplayer map produces no memory growth (check VMA stats)
- [ ] Shutdown path destroys all Vulkan objects without leaks (validation layer reports no objects alive at destroy)

### Performance
- [ ] Frame time at parity with OpenGL driver on mid-range discrete GPU at 1080p
- [ ] No redundant pipeline state switches per frame (verify with RenderDoc)
- [ ] Pipeline cache hit rate > 95% after second launch

### Platform
- [ ] Builds and runs on Windows 10+ (Win32 surface)
- [ ] Builds and runs on Linux with X11 (XCB surface)
- [ ] Builds and runs on macOS 12+ via MoltenVK (Metal surface)

## Reference
- Full spec testing checklist at specs/vulkan.md
- OpenGL driver as visual reference for correctness

## Acceptance Criteria
- All correctness items pass
- All stability items pass
- Performance at parity with OpenGL driver
- All platform targets build and run
